title: Excavation and Shoring Resource Estimate
brief: A site supervisor's resource estimate for trench excavation, utility bedding, and shoring installation on a municipal water line project, drafted from site engineering specs and crew rates.

slip.document:
# Excavation and Shoring Resource Estimate
Subproject: 8-Inch Water Main Extension - Station 14+00 to Station 18+00
Superintendent: Derek Vance
Date: 04/14/2026

## Project Parameters and Material Takeoff
Total trench length: 400 linear ft
Average trench depth: 8 ft
Average trench width: 3 ft
Aggregate bedding spec: 6 inches of No. 57 stone placed along entire run

| Item | Volume (cu yd) | Unit Cost | Total Cost |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Trench Excavation (in situ) | 355.6 | $12.50 | $4,445.00 |
| Crushed Stone Bedding (#57) | 22.2 | $38.00 | $843.60 |
| 8-Inch C900 PVC Pipe | 400.0 linear ft | $24.00 | $9,600.00 |
| Select Backfill (Imported) | 311.1 | $18.50 | $5,755.35 |

Aggregate bedding calculation checks at 22.2 cu yd.
Based on line totals, the estimated combined material and excavation expense is $23,643.95 before labor.

## Equipment and Labor Allocation
- Standard production rate: 80 linear ft per 8-hour shift
- Schedule duration: 5 working shifts (40 equipment operating hours)
- Crew composition: 1 operator, 2 pipelayers, 2 laborers
- Total craft labor hours: 200 craft hours (5 workers x 40 hours)
- Excavator: CAT 320 with 1.2 cu yd bucket
- Compactor: Walk-behind vibratory trench roller (40 hours)

## Protective Systems and Site Safety
- Soil classification: Type B cohesive soil across full cut
- Required protective system: Pre-engineered hydraulic aluminum trench shields (8 ft x 16 ft units)
- Ladder spacing requirement: locate egress ladders within 50 ft lateral travel distance for all workers in the trench
- Atmospheric testing required daily prior to entry due to parallel live sanitary sewer line
- Spoil pile management: keep excavated spoils setback minimum 2 ft from trench edge

errors.quote: locate egress ladders within 50 ft lateral travel distance for all workers in the trench
errors.explanation: OSHA 29 CFR 1926.651(c)(2) requires structural ramps or ladders in trenches 4 feet or deeper to be located so as to require no more than 25 feet of lateral travel for employees, not 50 feet.
errors.fix: locate egress ladders within 25 ft lateral travel distance for all workers in the trench
